violation_type.title: Private Water Supply Maintained in Safe and Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3431(1))
violation_type.short_title: Private Water Supply Maintained in Safe and Sanitary Manner
violation_type.typical_finding: This standard was evaluated and compliance was not met. The operation previously was not maintaining the water supply in a safe and sanitary manner.   This standard is now in compliance. Routine testing is being done on the well water to ensure it's being maintained at the proper levels.
